posts.zh:
dsh-undo-plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a83ebfe0fccc42f60d4d.html
posts.en:
dsh-undo-plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a83ebfe0fccc42f60d4d.html
